column1: # Manifest of libswe/ as vendored inside the PyPI pyswisseph 2.08.00-1 sdist.
# This is the 2.08 baseline scripts/fetch-2.08-baseline.ps1 downloads and checks against this
# file. It is NOT the v2.08.00a git tag in aloistr/swisseph -- that tag is an incomplete
# snapshot (no swecl.c, swehouse.c or swehel.c at all, and a truncated swephexp.h at 14 KB
# against the real 38,410 bytes recorded below). Diffing against it silently produces a wrong
# work queue for three of the five files the 2.10.03 port touches. See CONTRIBUTING.md.
# Checked by scripts/fetch-2.08-baseline.ps1. Regenerate only if the pinned sdist itself changes
# (it should not: PyPI release files are immutable), never to paper over a verification failure.
